statement: Largest known training run >= 5e27 FLOP (Epoch AI; by 2027-12-31)
status_at_phase_end: Not met: largest known run ~9.4e26 FLOP (Epoch, 'Likely', 90% CI ~4.6e26-1.8e27), about 5x below threshold. Epoch's 4-6x/yr frontier trend would put end-2027 near 5e27, so the indicator sits close to the trend line; multi-hundred-thousand-GPU clusters running in 2026 make a >1e27 run in 2027 likely.

items.summary: Entering 2026, the largest known training run was a Bloc A model from July 2025 at ~5e26 FLOP (Epoch 'Speculative'); this record stood for ~14 months.
items.detail: xAI Grok 4, ~5e26 FLOP, Colossus 1 (~200k H100/H200), Epoch estimate.

items.summary: A Bloc A developer's owner said its newest cluster was training seven models in parallel, including two flagship variants of ~6T and ~10T parameters; site reported at ~550,000 latest-generation GPUs. No compute disclosed; trackers name this the most likely first >1e27 run.
items.detail: Elon Musk post on Colossus 2 (Memphis), April 2026 (exact date approximate); Grok 5 unreleased as of Nov 2026. DatacentersX frontier runs table.

items.summary: A Bloc A developer released a flagship trained on >=100,000 latest-generation accelerators (pretraining ~Jan-Jul 2026), becoming the largest known run.
items.detail: OpenAI GPT-6 Astra, Stargate Abilene, NVIDIA GB200.

items.summary: Epoch AI estimated the new record run at 9.4e26 FLOP ('Likely'; 90% interval 4.6e26-1.8e27; P(>1e27) = 0.44), revised down from ~1e27; split ~7.5e26 pretraining + ~1.4e26 RL. Threshold 5e27 is ~5x higher.
items.detail: Epoch model page GPT-6 Astra (row changed 2026-10-15); estimate from chip count x time x utilisation Monte Carlo. Reported via The Hum and Exponential Tracker.

items.summary: Epoch has no compute estimate for several Bloc A flagships of 2026 (from at least three developers), so the 'largest known run' may understate the true frontier.
items.detail: No Epoch figure for Claude Opus 5.5, Gemini 4 Argon, GPT-5.5, Muse Spark (The Hum, Oct 2026; DatacentersX). Date approximate.

items.summary: Epoch's trend dashboard puts frontier training compute growth at 4-6x per year (doubling ~4.6-6 months) and gigawatt data-centre build time ~2 years. Extrapolating from 9.4e26 (Sept 2026) gives roughly 3-7e27 by end-2027 - straddling the threshold.
items.detail: Epoch 'Trends in AI' page (accessed Nov 2026); extrapolation is this ledger's arithmetic, not Epoch's.
